name: Tiveck
excerpt: Tiveck is the location of the Admiralty's main building.
notes:
- Tiveck houses the main building of the Admiralty.
- The Cartographic Division operates out of the upper two floors of this building.
- The archive of the Cartographic Division is located in a separate, humidity-controlled vault in the basement of the Admiralty's main building.
